role: Commanding officer, CNV Rigel Ascendant; Sovereign Ethics Bureau; once Galen's psychological advisor during early Valkyrie vetting
_name_note: Author decision: canon name is Captain Rhea Solari. Resolved in the final (v3) manuscript, which uses Rhea Solari throughout.

age.tell: aged the way orbital command officers do: trim lines, eyes too sharp to soften

canon: backdrop, seal, 'Trim lines, eyes too sharp to soften, voice held back' (CH07/CH11)
proposed_needs_author_approval: skin, face, eye color, hair, age, uniform cut and color, collar seal
_provenance.rejected: Old approved Supabase images (mid-30s, dark brown ponytail) rejected 2026-11-14 in favor of the late-50s silver-haired draft.
_provenance.seal: public/visual-references/sovereign-ethics-bureau-seal.png (SVG alongside), designed 2026-11-14 from canon: 'the oversight seal-cold, sharp, bloodless' (CH02) and SOVRIN's angular white geometry (CH12). Deliberate opposite of the Valkyrie patch.
_provenance.approved_portrait: public/visual-references/rhea-solari-portrait.png: first OpenAI render, author-approved 2026-11-14. Collar pin, cuff bars and backdrop watermark all landed. Its warm desk lamp is not canon for transmissions.
